description: Voivodeship letters for Polish professional plates (Załącznik nr 8 to the professional-registration regulation): one letter per voivodeship — the primary letters only, without the ordinary-series second letters. Powiats are identified by numbers 01-99 assigned in the same annex; the per-voivodeship number ranges (e.g. dolnośląskie 01-30) are not enforced here.
